# Arnav Gupta — Engineering Dashboard

## Navigation Instructions for LLMs & Agents

This site is a single-page Next.js static dashboard (`https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/`) organized into five interactive tabs. You can link users directly to any section using `?tab=<name>`:

- **Overview**: `https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/?tab=overview` — Headline, bio, key metrics, recent roles summary, and self-hosted stack summary.
- **Experience**: `https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/?tab=experience` — Detailed work history across Google, Bizad, AccioJob, ScrapUncle, and IIITD.
- **Research & Security**: `https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/?tab=research` — Published IEEE TMA '25 paper, EALS framework, Android side-channel BTP, GPU-Based Firewall, and IIITD education.
- **Self-Hosted**: `https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/?tab=selfhosted` — Homelab (`ARCUBE`) and Dokploy VPS (`qubit`) infrastructure plus featured reads from ARSphere (`blog.kontour.in`).
- **Connect**: `https://arnavgupta2003.github.io/?tab=connect` — Contact form (n8n -> Slack), Cal.com 15-min/30-min scheduling, vCard download, social links, and QR code.
